customManagers.description: Keep the ruff/mypy pins in the CI workflow in sync with pyproject.toml [dependency-groups].

packageRules.description: Update the ruff/mypy dev-tool pins in pyproject.toml and .github/workflows/deploy-test.yml in a single PR.

docker/constraints.txt is a fully-resolved snapshot derived from uv.lock (see its header and README). Bumping an individual pin - especially a transitive one such as pydantic-core that a parent like pydantic pins exactly - breaks the locked set, so `pip install -c docker/constraints.txt` becomes unresolvable; groupName only batches PRs and does not guarantee compatibility. Therefore Renovate must not update this file on its own: regenerate it from uv.lock (`uv lock` then re-sync the versions). The CI docker build fails closed on any drift.
